assertions.evidence: The plan proposes a `choice` primitive with three options that returns probabilities per option ("Take the highest-probability choice. Set a confidence floor..."). It explicitly contrasts this with parsing generated text ("replace the guess with a probability-based judgment").
Step 3 says: "Include a `none`/fallback criterion if any input could plausibly fit none of the three (even if you then default to `support` in code)."
